podcast.title: First Demo Delivery
podcast.body: In the early 1990s, Jeremy Taggart, then a shy kid with big glasses, personally delivered Our Lady Peace's first-ever demo cassette to a radio station host. The host, unfortunately, didn't recognize its significance at the time. "It wasn't until much, much later that I realized that the kid with the big glasses was Jeremy Taggart, the drummer for RLAD Peace, and that he had presented me with the group's first ever demo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
